source_title: Solo Leveling: 4 Strongest Hunters In Anime Sequel, Officially Ranked
source_excerpt:
Solo Leveling is one of the most loved anime of all time. It has managed to away the competition in no time. The series did not complicate things, and, in fact, it kept them simple. Solo Leveling gave the audience an action-packed adventure along with a good story sprinkled all over it. These two things, combined with a strong lead, turned Solo Leveling into an overnight sensation.
So far, the anime has released two seasons, both of which have been received positively by the audience. Even though it's early days, fans have already seen multiple powerful individuals who have insanely overpowered abilities. But there are still many hunters who are yet to show off their talent. When the next installment/sequel finally drops, Solo Leveling fans will get to see many incredibly strong Hunters who strike fear into their victims' hearts with nothing but a cold glare.
Christopher Reed is a national-level hunter, meaning he is one of the most powerful individuals in the world . Christopher Reed has yet to make his debut in the anime, but that will change once the next season of Solo Leveling is released.
As a national-level hunter, Christopher Reed has the power of the rulers, which makes him physically stronger and faster than most individuals. With his skill set, it is possible for him to take on almost all kinds of magical beasts. When the anime finally reveals Christopher Reed, fans will be hoping that he gets more screen time than he did in the manga. So far, the studio has done a fabulous job of adapting the source material, but it's things like these that will truly challenge the studio's capability. If they manage to give Christopher Reed proper time without disturbing the overall story, it would be another feather in the cap for the studio.
Yuri Orloff was an S-rank hunter from Russia who specialized in barrier techniques. He was confident that his barriers could stop any threat in their tracks, and there was some truth to it, which is why he was renowned throughout the world. He was approached by the Japanese government after they lost almost all of their S-rank hunters in the Jeju Island raid. The losses that they incurred forced their hand, so they had to look elsewhere to find someone willing to help them defend against the S-rank gate that would open in Tokyo.
Yuri Orloff took this opportunity with both hands as he knew that the Japanese government would be willing to pay an absurd amount of money. Ultimately, his greed and overconfidence cost him a great deal, as he was killed by a giant that came out of the gate and the door.
Thomas Andre is widely believed to be the strongest hunter in the world. He came from rags, but that didn't stop him from climbing the ranks and becoming one of the most feared individuals in the world. Thomas Andre was blessed by the rulers who wanted him to take down Kamish, the deadliest magical beast in humankind's history. The battle against the beast resulted in the deaths of countless hunters and innocent people. Naturally, when Thomas Andre and the rest of the national hunters took the beast down. They became heroes and were treated as such.
As someone who has been the recipient of the Rulers' power, Thomas Andre is extremely dangerous in combat. He has the means to fight someone of Jinwoo's capability without any major problems. When Thomas Andre finally gets the opportunity to show off his strength in the upcoming sequel, there is no doubt that fans will be rather happy. However, they will have to wait for Solo Leveling Season 3, as Beyond the System is not going to give him much, if any, screen time at all.
Go Gunhee was the chairman of the Korean Hunters Association. As the first S-rank hunter in the country, he was treated with a lot of respect by the people around him. When he awakened as a hunter, he was confident that he would use his strength for the greater good so that he could help people. Unfortunately, he was already rather old, so he couldn't stay in the field for too long. So he had to retire and let the others step forward and take the mantle. Go Gunhee decided to stay on as the chairman. He had hoped that healing magic would be able to reverse the effects on his body, but it was to no avail. Go Gunhee is not an ordinary hunter by any means. In fact, he is the recipient of an absurd amount of power. To be clearer, he was the vessel of the ruler's authority, which gave him a huge edge over the rest of human beings.
